# Scale X

> Scale X is an all in one scaling coach for coaches and info businesses doing $10k to $100k per month. It connects business signals, finds the constraint slowing growth, and turns the diagnosis into one weekly action.

## What Scale X does

- Audience: coaches, info businesses and small teams between $10k and $100k in monthly revenue.
- Core workflow: connect Stripe, calculate revenue and funnel rates in code, identify the most important controllable gap, then run a focused action.
- Operating context: acquisition, sales, delivery, content and booked calls can be viewed together.
- Integrations: Stripe, iClosed, Calendly, Instagram and YouTube, depending on the workflow and plan.
- AI model: Scale X supports a bring your own Anthropic API key setup. The key is encrypted and is not returned to the browser after setup.
- Product principle: the output is a prioritized next move, not another dashboard to interpret.
